_comment: Copy to config/projects.json (gitignored) to use. Project-level overrides for Claude Code, which keys projects by working directory - so renaming or moving a folder starts a brand-new project and splits its history. Use `merge` to stitch those back together, and `displayNames` to override the label. Every key starting with `_` is documentation and is ignored.

merge._comment: "<source directory>": "<target directory>" - the source's sessions, tokens, cost and runtime are folded into the target. Use the directory names exactly as they appear under ~/.claude/projects. Chains are followed (A->B->C all land on C); a cycle is ignored and logged as a warning.

displayNames._comment: "<directory>": "<label>" - overrides the name shown in the UI, which otherwise comes from the transcript's `cwd` field. Applies to the target of a merge. Useful when two spellings encode to the same directory name (`My App` and `My_App` both become `My-App`) and the parser picks the one you don't want.
